primary_saturation_guard.quantity: all-small-mammal occupied capture trap-nights / observed active trap-nights within the exact-3-night plot-event
rationale: single-catch trap dependence increases with trap saturation
0.30 is a conservative pre-effect operational guard
the cutoff was frozen before W/B or abundance-response slopes were opened
primary_saturation_guard.high_saturation_sessions: excluded from primary W/B density-response analysis; retained only for prespecified sensitivity or a separately modeled observation process

abundance_predictor.definition: minimum number known alive based on resolved tagged individuals known alive across eligible event sequence within plot
abundance_predictor.role: population-state abundance index, not true density
abundance_predictor.rationale: O'Fallon et al. 2025 used plot-event MNKA for NEON Peromyscus and notes strong positive correlation with capture-probability-adjusted population estimates

secondary_abundance_sensitivity: unique tagged target individuals observed in the event per active trap-night
model-based closed/SCR density only if separately estimable and preregistered before W/B effects
required_pre_effect_diagnostics: MNKA distribution and within-taxon temporal variation
MNKA versus unique observed tagged individuals
stop_or_escalate_rules: STOP simple coordinate-density route if MNKA has insufficient within-taxon variation after the target and saturation guards
STOP or use a separately preregistered observation model if abundance is inseparable from trap saturation
do not raise the 0.30 saturation cutoff after W/B effects are viewed
do not replace MNKA with a more favorable abundance proxy after W/B effects are viewed
